newsitem.title: UK: British factory gate prices rise 0.2 pct in April.
newsitem.headline: British factory gate prices rise 0.2 pct in April.

text.p: British factory gate prices rose 0.2 percent in April, in line with analysts' expectations, but industry's input prices fell sharply by 1.9 percent, official figures showed on Monday.
Factory gate or output prices rose 0.8 in the year to April while input prices of materials and fuel fell 10.5 percent year-on-year.

"Obviously the scale of the (input price) decrease is a bit of a surprise but we did have quite a sharp appreciation of sterling over the month of April and we saw oil prices coming down in dollar terms too," said Philip Shaw, economist at Union Plc.
Analysts said the large gap between input and output prices was probably due to firms trying to rebuild profits, although rising wages would trim these profits.
Financial markets were little moved by the figures with sterling remaining steady against the mark at 2.72/3 marks.
